name: St Martins Lane London
positioning: Philippe Starck-designed lifestyle boutique hotel on St Martin's Lane in Covent Garden, in London's West End
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led base in Covent Garden and the West End theatre district
Families or friends who need rooms with multiple beds

facts.text: The hotel is on St Martin's Lane in Covent Garden, in London's West End, close to major attractions and theatres.
The hotel was designed by Philippe Starck.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light and city views.
The Corner Suite has dual-aspect windows and a large living area.
The Studio has an open-plan layout with a freestanding bathtub.
Suites include a complimentary non-alcoholic minibar.
Larger rooms and suites accommodate families, including options with multiple beds.
The hotel has a fully equipped gym.
The hotel has eight meeting and event spaces.
EllaMia is a modern cafe bringing a taste of LA's craft coffee scene to London; by night, EllaMia After Dark serves bites and cocktails.
Breakfast is served daily at Restaurant 45.

highlights.text: A design-led hotel by Philippe Starck in Covent Garden.
Blind Spot is a hidden, late-night speakeasy bar serving cocktails.
Deluxe Garden Rooms have a private furnished terrace overlooking a garden.
The One Bedroom Suite is on the top floor, with a separate living area and elevated views.
The Penthouse has expansive living and dining spaces and an open-plan kitchen.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the heart of London's vibrant West End theatre district, a lively central setting.
Views vary by room type: the Standard Room overlooks Hop Gardens or Mays Court, while the garden terraces and elevated views come with specific rooms and suites.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the central London location.
